data.name: Eldrem: Kingdoms
data.detailed_description:
Explore a shattered world, discover fantastic creatures, tame them and summon their powers.

Become the Apex Predator

A dragon is NOT the most powerful being in the world of Eldrem, but you WILL  be. 

Unlike other creature collectors, where the creatures fight independently, the fantastic beasts of Eldrem give your character their power.

Every spell you cast comes from your currently summoned creature. 

Every creature species has it's own set of spells.

Need an ice shield ? Summon an Ice Ursaleo.

Want to fly ? Summon your dragon!

Pick your creatures carefully, evolve them and make use of their skills in real time combat to defeat the greatest foes in the land.

Hunt, Tame and Breed the most powerful creatures

  • Discover rare creatures in the open world of Eldrem. Collect them, level them up to increase your character's power.

  • Transfer stats bonuses and skills to the next generation through breeding.

  • Forge a strong bond with your creatures to unlock their powers.

  • Keep your creatures well fed and happy and they will reward you with their full potential.

  • Ride them across the open plains, fight with them side by side of burn your enemies from above

Craft and Build your way to power

  • Craft gear for you and your creatures to enhance your power.

  • Build up your own floating island, from a tiny village to a mighty fortress

  • Use your creatures as beasts of burden or helpers to assist your builders.

  • Construct structures that assist you in breeding, improving and raising your creature army

  • Hire NPCs to help you in your most common tasks, like creature handlers that keep your creatures fed or the Warden who manages your town's day to day operations.

  • Fend off attackers that seek to destroy your town

Current state of the game

  • The game is currently under development closing the pre-alpha stage

  • Main game systems such as taming, combat, summoning are being completed.

  • Elemental combat and creature spell borrowing is in the final phases of implementation.

  • Player, NPC and Creature stats, skills and progression systems have been implemented.

  • Our backend infrastructure is built to handle player profiles, creature databases and inventory storage

  • We have three islands to explore and hunt for creatures in.

Our next objective is to open the game to a close group of players to test the client and server under load, and start collecting, using and upgrading creatures.

The first stage of Eldrem will be a solo PVE experience. 

In the future, multiplayer features will be added and you will be able to:

  • Fight your friends and rivals in PVP duels or large battles

  • Explore dungeons and defeat dangerous bosses with your friends

  • Create powerful guilds with their own economy

  • Share, trade or borrow creatures with your friends.

  • and even brag to everyone about your legendary Thundersheep that ate the dragon instead of the other way around

data.short_description: Ride your dragon to the top of the food chain as you tame, breed, and raise fantastic creatures. Channel your creatures magic powers in brutal third person combat. Explore the open world, discover new creatures, wield their skills and build your fortress in the Crystal Sky Islands.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: intel core I3 6300T or equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: nVidia 1060
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 12 GB available space
  • Sound Card: On-board
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: intel i5 13500 or equivalent
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: nVidia 3070
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 12 GB available space
  • Sound Card: On-board
